name: auction-platform
description: Enterprise-grade real-time online auction platform built with the MERN stack and Socket.IO

scripts.dev: npx concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "blue,green" "npm --prefix server run server" "npm --prefix client start"
scripts.build: cd client && npm install --legacy-peer-deps && npm run build
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install

author: Pranav Gour
